company: Atlas Arteria Limited (ATLAX) and Atlas Arteria International Limited (ATLIX)
title: Securities Trading (Windows) Policy
date_next_review: Reviewed once every two years (next by February 2027)

tiers.name: Staff
tiers.description: Employees, contractors and consultants of Atlas Arteria and its controlled entities. Subject to the windows regime, pre-clearance through the ATLAX Company Secretary, the short-term dealing ban and the ban on limiting the economic risk of unvested or restricted securities. Not caught by the margin lending / secured financing ban.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of ATLAX and ATLIX and directors appointed by Atlas Arteria to wholly or partially owned entities who are not employees. Same windows regime as Staff, plus Chair pre-clearance for sales, three-trading-day clearance validity, the margin lending / secured financing ban, ASX reporting via the director disclosure deed and a minimum holding requirement.

tiers.name: CEO and direct reports to the CEO
tiers.description: The Atlas Arteria CEO and those reporting directly to the CEO. Treated with Directors for the margin lending / secured financing ban, the expectation not to trade actively, Chair pre-clearance of sales and the three-trading-day execution limit; exemptions for this group also need ATLAX and ATLIX Chair approval.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: Immediate family (spouse, de facto partner, child or step-child under 18, financially dependent relatives), other relatives in the same household, any person over whose investment actions the Staff member or Director may have influence, SMSFs and trading or investment accounts, controlled or majority-held companies, investment companies in which they are a significant beneficiary or involved in investment decisions, and trusts they control or are sole or major beneficiary of. Requests to exempt an independent spouse or partner will be considered.

definitions.hedging_definition: not enter into any transaction that limits the economic risk of holding unvested or restricted securities. This includes not entering any transaction to manage the risk of the timing, likelihood or manner of vesting, or unrestricted vesting, of any unvested or restricted Atlas Arteria securities.

windows.end_anchor: four weeks after the window commences

windows.start_anchor: at least one day after the Annual General Meeting
windows.end_anchor: four weeks after the window commences

windows.start_anchor: at least one day after lodgement with ASIC or ASX of a disclosure document or a cleansing statement for a capital raising
windows.end_anchor: four weeks after the window commences

windows.start_anchor: any other window specified by the ATLIX and ATLAX Boards, including a special window following an ASX release in respect of previously price sensitive information
windows.end_anchor: four weeks after the window commences

windows.start_anchor: end of a four week trading window
windows.end_anchor: commencement of the next trading window

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The ATLAX and ATLIX Boards open windows at their discretion and may decline to open or may shut a window: 'If however, immediately prior to or during these windows Atlas Arteria is aware of price sensitive information regarding the entity (for example a pending significant investment), the window will not be opened or will be shut as the case may be.' The policy does not say whether the reason is disclosed; a refusal of pre-clearance is final and must be kept confidential by the person refused.

rules.detail: Derivatives of Atlas Arteria are expressly within the windows regime with no venue limitation, so an OTC put or call written or bought over ALX securities may only be traded inside a four week window, with pre-clearance through the ATLAX Company Secretary (and the relevant Chair for Directors, the CEO and CEO direct reports if the leg is a sale).
rules.evidence: The windows trading policy means that trading in both securities and derivatives of Atlas Arteria can only occur at the discretion of the ATLAX and ATLIX Boards during the four week window commencing after:

rules.section: Restrictions on Trading - Hedging and Derivatives
rules.detail: Absolute ban, with no clearance or exemption route identified, on any transaction limiting the economic risk of unvested securities, including transactions managing the risk of timing, likelihood or manner of vesting. Directed at Staff; Directors holding director incentive plan securities are not named in this clause.
rules.evidence: Staff who hold unvested or restricted Atlas Arteria securities must: ... not enter into any transaction that limits the economic risk of holding unvested or restricted securities.

rules.section: Restrictions on Trading - Hedging and Derivatives
rules.detail: The ban is expressed as 'unvested or restricted', so vested securities still subject to a plan restriction or holding lock are equally barred from any risk-limiting transaction, and the holder must also comply with the terms of issue of those securities.
rules.evidence: The use of derivative contracts in relation to unvested or restricted securities could distort the proper functioning of performance hurdles and reduce the intended alignment between management and shareholder interests.

rules.section: Policy; Restrictions on Trading - Hedging and Derivatives
rules.detail: The hedging ban is confined to unvested or restricted securities, so hedging vested unrestricted securities is not prohibited; it is caught only as trading in derivatives of Atlas Arteria, requiring an open window and pre-clearance, and it must not be short term (under six months).
rules.evidence: trading in both securities and derivatives of Atlas Arteria can only occur at the discretion of the ATLAX and ATLIX Boards during the four week window

rules.section: Policy; Restrictions on Trading - Short Term Dealing
rules.detail: Monetisation, prepaid forwards and collar-plus-loan structures are not named. A monetisation is caught as trading in derivatives or 'other financial products issued over or in respect of Atlas Arteria securities', so it needs an open window and pre-clearance; if it involves security over ALX securities it is separately banned for Directors, the CEO and CEO direct reports.
rules.evidence: Directors and Staff must not engage in short term or speculative trading in Atlas Arteria securities, or in derivative or other financial products issued over or in respect of Atlas Arteria securities.

rules.detail: Short selling is not named anywhere in the policy. A short position taken through a derivative would be caught by the windows, pre-clearance and short-term/speculative trading restrictions.
Securities lending is not mentioned and there is no definition of trading or dealing that would obviously sweep it in.

rules.section: Policy; Restrictions on Trading - Short Term Dealing
rules.detail: CFDs are not named but are derivatives or financial products issued over or in respect of ALX securities, so they require an open window and pre-clearance; in practice a CFD would breach the ban on short term or speculative trading.
rules.evidence: Directors and Staff must not engage in short term or speculative trading in Atlas Arteria securities, or in derivative or other financial products issued over or in respect of Atlas Arteria securities.

rules.detail: Flat ban on margin loans over ALX securities for ATLAX and ATLIX directors, with no clearance route; only the general exceptional-circumstances exemption could touch it.
rules.evidence: ATLAX and ATLIX directors along with the CEO and direct reports to the CEO, must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.

rules.tier: CEO and direct reports to the CEO
rules.detail: The same flat ban extends to the CEO and everyone reporting directly to the CEO.
rules.evidence: ATLAX and ATLIX directors along with the CEO and direct reports to the CEO, must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.

rules.detail: The margin lending clause names only directors, the CEO and CEO direct reports. Staff below that level are not prohibited from margin lending over ALX securities, and no clearance is expressly required for taking out the loan itself.

Granting security over ALX securities to support a financing is prohibited as an 'other secured financing arrangement over their Atlas Arteria Securities'. A charge or pledge unconnected with a financing is not addressed.
rules.evidence: must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.

rules.tier: CEO and direct reports to the CEO
rules.detail: Same prohibition on granting security over ALX securities for a financing.
rules.evidence: must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.

rules.detail: No encumbrance restriction applies to Staff below the CEO's direct reports, and there is no definition of trading that makes granting security a dealing.

The ban is not limited to margin loans: any secured financing arrangement over ALX securities is prohibited, regardless of vesting state, lender or loan-to-value ratio, and no approver can clear it in the ordinary course.
rules.evidence: must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.

rules.tier: CEO and direct reports to the CEO
rules.detail: Identical blanket ban on any secured financing arrangement over ALX securities for the CEO and CEO direct reports.
rules.evidence: ATLAX and ATLIX directors along with the CEO and direct reports to the CEO, must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.

rules.detail: Staff outside the CEO's direct reports are not subject to any secured financing restriction; the loan leg of a funded collar would be unregulated for them, although any transfer of the shares to the lender and the derivative legs remain subject to windows and pre-clearance.

rules.section: Restrictions on Trading - Short Term Dealing
rules.detail: Six month rule applied expressly to derivatives and other financial products over ALX securities as well as to the securities themselves, so a collar with a tenor of less than six months is prohibited outright. Carve-out only for the sale of shares vesting under a Staff equity plan within six months of vesting, and that sale still needs a window and pre-clearance.
rules.evidence: Directors and Staff must not engage in short term or speculative trading in Atlas Arteria securities, or in derivative or other financial products issued over or in respect of Atlas Arteria securities. Short term means a term of less than a six month period.

clearance.approver: ATLAX Company Secretary (for the ATLAX Company Secretary, the Atlas Arteria CEO)
clearance.evidence: Trades must be pre-cleared through the ATLAX Company Secretary (or in the case of the ATLAX Company Secretary, through the Atlas Arteria CEO). ... Staff and Directors must complete and submit to the ATLAX Company Secretary the Securities Trading Request From to request a pre-clearance to trade in Atlas Arteria securities.

clearance.approver: ATLAX Company Secretary; sales must also be pre-cleared through the ATLAX or ATLIX Chair as relevant
clearance.post_trade_to: ATLAX Company Secretary (under the director disclosure deed), for ASX reporting within five business days
clearance.evidence: If pre-clearance is given for a specific transaction, then the order must be placed and executed within three trading days following the granting of the pre-clearance ... The director disclosure deed executed by all ATLAX and ATLIX directors requires them to report any trades to the ATLAX Company Secretary within three business days

clearance.tier: CEO and direct reports to the CEO
clearance.approver: ATLAX Company Secretary; sales must also be pre-cleared through the ATLAX or ATLIX Chair as relevant
clearance.evidence: In the case of ATLAX and ATLIX directors, the CEO and direct reports to the CEO, they are expected to not actively trade in Atlas Arteria securities and if they wish to sell must also pre-clear these trades through the ATLAX or ATLIX Chair (as relevant).

short_term.basis: term of the trade or instrument; expressly applied to derivatives and other financial products over ALX securities
carve_outs: sale of shares vesting in accordance with the terms of a Staff equity plan within six months of the vesting, in accordance with the plan terms and minimum shareholding requirements (still requires a trading window and pre-clearance)
short_term.evidence: Short term means a term of less than a six month period. This does not prevent the sale of shares vesting in accordance with the terms of a Staff equity plan within six months of the vesting

exceptions.approver: ATLAX Company Secretary and CEO in writing; for the CEO and CEO direct reports also the ATLAX and ATLIX Chairs; for Directors the ATLAX or ATLIX Chair; for the Chairs, the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee
exceptions.evidence: a declaration that the person faces significant financial hardship that could not have been reasonably foreseen ... and that selling Atlas Arteria securities is the only practical method of overcoming the financial hardship

exceptions.approver: ATLAX Company Secretary and CEO in writing (plus Chairs as applicable)
exceptions.evidence: or a requirement to comply with a court order or court enforceable undertaking or compulsion by law or regulation

Grants, allocations or vesting, rights or awards of Atlas Arteria Securities pursuant to an employee, executive or director incentive plan under the terms of that plan and relevant offer document. However, the subsequent dealing of any ALX Securities acquired pursuant to an employee, executive or director incentive plan would need to take place during a trading window and would require pre-clearance in accordance with this Policy.

Participation in a dividend reinvestment plan (while electing or changing an election to participate in a dividend reinvestment plan does not require pre-clearance, such election or changes to your election may only be made during a trading window).
Acceptance of a takeover offer or participation in a scheme of arrangement.
Participation in a share purchase plan or rights issue or public offerings relating to Atlas Arteria Securities.

An investment in, or trading in units of, a fund or other scheme (other than a scheme only investing in Atlas Arteria Securities) where the assets of the fund or other scheme are invested at the discretion of an unrelated third party

Transfers where there is no change in beneficial ownership of Atlas Arteria securities (for example, transferring a personal holding to a self-managed superannuation fund or transferring from an employee holding to a personal holding in your name).

financing.minimum_shareholding_requirement: Yes for directors: ATLAX and ATLIX directors must acquire and maintain a minimum holding of Atlas Arteria Securities equal to one year of the base non-executive director fee, with three years from the later of the policy date or their appointment to accumulate it. Staff 'minimum shareholding requirements' are also referenced in the short-term dealing carve-out. The policy does not say whether hedged or collared shares count towards the minimum.

external_documents: Securities Trading Request Form (pre-clearance request form submitted to the ATLAX Company Secretary)
Director disclosure deed executed by all ATLAX and ATLIX directors
Terms of issue / offer documents of the employee, executive and director incentive plans
exemption_authority: Exceptional circumstances exemption. Any exemption must be approved in writing by the ATLAX Company Secretary and CEO; for the CEO and CEO direct reports also in writing by the ATLAX and ATLIX Chairs; for Directors by the ATLAX or ATLIX Chair; for the ATLAX or ATLIX Chairs by the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee. Exemptions to sell outside a window additionally require a written no-inside-information undertaking plus unforeseeable severe hardship or legal compulsion, with sale the only practical method.
jurisdiction_overlays: Bermuda: Atlas Arteria International Limited is a Bermuda company (stapled structure), and the policy is adopted by both the ATLAX and ATLIX Boards

US ownership restriction: Atlas Arteria securities cannot be held by or for the account or benefit of any U.S. person that is not a qualified purchaser under the U.S. Investment Company Act (from the covering ASX release, not the policy itself)

bespoke_clauses.clause: The windows trading policy means that trading in both securities and derivatives of Atlas Arteria can only occur at the discretion of the ATLAX and ATLIX Boards during the four week window commencing after: the release of annual and half yearly results; the Annual General Meeting; and lodgement with ASIC or ASX of a disclosure document or a cleansing statement for a capital raising.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: There is no default open period: every leg of a collar (entry, roll, unwind, physical settlement) must be executed inside a Board-opened four week window that may be withheld or shut without notice.

bespoke_clauses.clause: ATLAX and ATLIX directors along with the CEO and direct reports to the CEO, must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar secured on the collared shares is expressly prohibited for directors, the CEO and CEO direct reports, but the ban does not reach Staff below that level.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors and Staff must not engage in short term or speculative trading in Atlas Arteria securities, or in derivative or other financial products issued over or in respect of Atlas Arteria securities. Short term means a term of less than a six month period.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar must have a term of at least six months and must not be structured with early unwind or knock-out features that make it short term or speculative in substance.

bespoke_clauses.clause: In the case of ATLAX and ATLIX directors, the CEO and direct reports to the CEO, they are expected to not actively trade in Atlas Arteria securities and if they wish to sell must also pre-clear these trades through the ATLAX or ATLIX Chair (as relevant).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even where a structure is technically permitted, the senior group is expected to be inactive, so a bank should assume any derivative programme for them attracts Chair-level scrutiny.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If pre-clearance is given for a specific transaction, then the order must be placed and executed within three trading days following the granting of the pre-clearance. Any part of the order that is not actioned within this time must be pre-cleared again or cancelled.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Pricing, documentation and execution of both collar legs must complete inside three trading days of clearance or the clearance must be sought again.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A pre-clearance can be withdrawn if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances. Any pre-clearance to trade can be given or refused by the clearer in their discretion, without giving any reasons. A decision to refuse pre-clearance is final and binding.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank cannot rely on a granted clearance surviving to settlement, and there is no appeal if clearance for an unwind or settlement is refused.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Staff who hold unvested or restricted Atlas Arteria securities must ... not enter into any transaction that limits the economic risk of holding unvested or restricted securities. This includes not entering any transaction to manage the risk of the timing, likelihood or manner of vesting, or unrestricted vesting.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The hedging ban is limited to unvested or restricted securities, so a collar over vested unrestricted shares is not caught by it; but the collar must not be sized so that it economically covers unvested awards as well.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Trades in Atlas Arteria ... are prohibited for Atlas Arteria Staff and their Associates, as defined above, outside of the designated trading windows.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Booking the collar through a family trust, SMSF, controlled company or spouse does not escape the windows, pre-clearance or (for directors and the CEO group) the secured financing ban.

bespoke_clauses.clause: ATLAX and ATLIX directors are required to acquire and maintain a minimum holding of Atlas Arteria Securities which equates to one year of the base non-executive director fee.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Directors must keep an unencumbered-equivalent holding, and the policy is silent on whether collared or pledged shares count towards it, so the bank should assume shares delivered under the collar reduce compliance.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The policy contains no provision dealing with sales by a third party (such as a lender) outside the holder's control, and no exemption other than exceptional circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If a financier ever sold collared shares outside a window there is no excluded-dealing safe harbour, and the holder would need a written exceptional-circumstances exemption from the Company Secretary and CEO (and Chairs).

summary: A funded collar is blocked for directors, the CEO and the CEO's direct reports, because they must not enter into margin loans or other secured financing arrangements over their Atlas Arteria Securities, and the only relief is a written exceptional-circumstances exemption drafted around forced sales and unforeseeable hardship. For Staff below that level the secured loan leg is not restricted, and a collar over vested unrestricted shares is possible in principle: the hedging ban reaches only unvested or restricted securities, and the derivative legs are simply trading in derivatives of Atlas Arteria. Any such structure must be entered inside a Board-opened four week window following results, the AGM or a capital raising, with prior written pre-clearance from the ATLAX Company Secretary (Chair as well for a sale by the senior group) and execution within three trading days, and the clearance can be withdrawn at any time before dealing. The tenor must be at least six months, because short term or speculative trading in derivatives or other financial products over ALX securities is expressly banned. Every later step, including roll, unwind and physical settlement, is a fresh trade needing its own window and pre-clearance, and there is no safe harbour for a lender's sale outside a window.
